evidence_items.locator: Executive summary, Operations Layer; operational details on page 25
evidence_items.explanation: Waymo disclosed remote contextual guidance before the post while distinguishing it from teleoperation. This makes the absence of an onboard driver insufficient to establish the absence of every human operational contribution.

evidence_items.locator: Opening discussion of the September 2023 Swiss Re comparison
evidence_items.explanation: The announcement describes a substantial comparison without onboard human drivers. Neither this announcement nor the original study establishes that the comparison excluded remote operational guidance.

The study replaced human crash participants with a simulated automated driver. This challenges an unrestricted claim about all comparisons, but is not an observed road-service dataset explicitly excluding remote assistance.

unresolved_gaps: The search did not establish a comprehensive denominator for 'essentially none.'
The examined road-service comparison does not quantify or exclude remote assistance.
